summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game spanning Level 0, Levels 1–5 and M.E.G. Base Gamma, with place-local simulations and authored scenes assembling spaces, actors and encounters around shared layout, loot, creature and NPC systems. Level 5's Terror Hotel now has an authored Beverly Room ballroom and a sim-built Main Hall, guest rooms, and residents; the ordered player behavior chain connects movement, combat, interaction, progression and HUD.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0's generated yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, loot, shifting walls, seeded moments and smilers/lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; car-park cells, agents, searchable loot, hounds and skin-stealers; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls, rooms, NPCs, supplies, hounds and Level 3 threshold; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; maze zones/crawl halls, hazards, loot, creature brigades and Gamma checkpoint; breakable walls and powered lifts lead to Levels 4 and 5.
places/gamma (3D) - M.E.G. Base Gamma interior; security hall, atrium/mall, faux town, traders, guards and residents; sim adds the locked Database computer.

places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office, a 64×64 m floor with perimeter/corner offices, fountains, break-room vending, Level 3 lift, stairs down to Level 5 and Base Omega; sim adds residents, offices and tasks.

places/level5 (3D) - Terror Hotel, a 96×60 m 1930s hotel; Main Hall and guest rooms from the scene Main Hall manager, Beverly Room ballroom, Boiler Room, lobby/library and sim-built characters, props and exits.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, actions, player template and HUD renderer.
templates/player.js - ordered behavior chain: humanoid-locomotion, player, interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, os, lockpick, horde, critter.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch, crouched eye height, computer view, seated eye and third-person death view.

places/<place>/sim.js - local setup/tick roots; Level 4 builds office systems, Level 5 lays hotel shell, lamps, radios, exits and residents; Level 5's scene Main Hall manager separately lays hall furnishings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place configuration and authored placements; Level 5 x0z0.scene holds the ballroom, Main Hall manager and Boiler heat manager.
places/level5/config.yaml - Level 5's dark, fogged 3D environment, colored sky, warm ambient light and scripts/look-level5.js post-processing.
scripts/ui.js with loot-ui.js, talk-ui.js, build-ui.js, stats-ui.js, craft-ui.js, os-ui.js, horde-ui.js, noclip-ui.js and lockpick-ui.js - HUD composition, level transition card and action overlays.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading behavior; player and M.E.G. NPC chains run it before their controllers.
scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml; scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with their data - per-level grids/layouts reused by simulation, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + scripts/lib/data/level3.yml + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings and routes for geometry, sim and creatures.
scripts/lib/level4.js - office room/wall plan, zones, sanity rates and names read by Level 4 geometry, resident/office systems and player.js.
scripts/lib/level5.js - the 96×60 m hotel plan, zones, openings, exits, arrivals, elevator/boiler layout and sanity rates shared by Level 5 geometry/sim and player.js.
scripts/lib/l5-boiler-plan.js - Boiler Room cell coordinates for machines, pipes, leaks, vents and heat parameters; geometry and active scripts/l5-heat.js share it.
scripts/lib/l5-hall-layout.js + scripts/lib/l5-hall-kit.js - Main Hall furnishing/door/fixture data and mesh helpers consumed by l5-hall-lay.js, l5-hall-geo.js and l5-hall-fix.js.
scripts/lib/seat.js - multi-occupant seat spots, claims and sit/stand animation; interact.js and Level 4/5 seats use the shared contract.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; Level 4 and Level 5 sims also export lay; places/gamma/sim.js also exports PEOPLE.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.

scripts/lib/level4.js - HALF/H/room-plan constants, ROOMS/WALLS/COLUMNS, zoneAt, DRAIN4, L4_NAMES and roomAt; scripts/lib/level5.js - T, ZONES, OPENINGS, EXITS, ARRIVALS, ELEVATORS, BOILER, facing, zoneAt, DRAIN5, ZONE_NAMES, PLACARDS.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js - roundsFor, speak, settle, tickPeople, PEOPLE4; scripts/l4-office.js - ears, phoneTask, update; scripts/computer.js - ears.
scripts/lib/os.js - PROFILE, mailsOf, filesOf, entriesOf, entryById, binOf, forumOf, passwordOf, runCmd; scripts/os.js - onInput, update; scripts/os-ui.js - osUi.
scripts/lib/clothes.js - fullLook, rollLevel, leveledRows, rollCloth, npcLook and clothing helpers; scripts/lib/breakables.js - wall/prop damage, sync and sweep helpers.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js - critter model/look/morph helpers; scripts/lib/seat.js - spotsOf, seatFor, sitDown, standUp, seatTick, claim, free; scripts/lockpick.js - onInput, update, startPick.

scripts/weapon-geo.js - geometry/collider; scripts/l5-boiler-geo.js, l5-boiler-props.js, l5-hall-geo.js, l5-hall-fix.js and l5-ball-geo.js - scripted geometry/collider; scripts/l5-heat.js - updateSchedule, update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, health/sanity, visited cells/zones, kills/deaths, equipment/inventory/ammo/condition, clothes, compass, crouch, meat and consumable counts/timers; player-local session holds transient combat/movement state.
scripts/stats.js - player.state owns HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates the sheet and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - player.state hunger/thirst, craftOpen/craftBench and payout redemption; crafts validate recipe/skill/materials.
scripts/horde.js - player.state horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing; spawned creature state carries the owning player's horde id.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.

scripts/interact.js and scripts/lib/seat.js - focus/loot menu/interaction plus player.state.sit and seat.state.by occupancy claims; NPCs own pockets/picked and per-player warned/angry state; containers own item lists/lock/scavenged state.
scripts/talk.js / scripts/samantha.js - dialogue and per-player talk memory are split across player/NPC; Samantha behavior owns her line/mode/session and trades from player.state.meat.

Place simulations own persisted build/schedule state (including Level 5 place.state.builtV); scripts/l5-heat.js owns vent phases and per-player heat warning/damage timers, writing player.state.heat and hp; Level 5 room doors own open/held state.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js chain: humanoid-locomotion reads prior movement before player writes control; interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, os, lockpick and horde handle ordered actions before critter behavior.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; player/enemy gaze and targeting consume camera direction/state; seat parenting and sit state lower the seated view.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; paired thresholds connect Levels 1–3; Level 3 sim lift → level5#l5-from-l3, Level 4 stairs → level5#l5-from-l4; Level 5 lift/stairs return to Level 3/4.

scripts/level-door.js trigger → paired arrival marker IDs (PAIR) or state.to fallback; Level 3/4/5 sims place inbound markers, and scripts/player.js chooses nearest safe spawn/door checkpoint after death.
scripts/player.js writes player.state.xfer on place change → scripts/ui.js draws named level transition card; level-door.js crossing uses the black transition.
interact.js focus/E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js sends text/actions via talk/talkdo/shop inputs to talk.js; NPC talk handlers can provide card options and react to talkopt.

talk.js or scripts/samantha.js writes NPC state.line and player subtitle/talk memory → talk-ui.js / ui.js; shop and Samantha offer actions update stock or consume player.state.meat and give readings/rewards.
interact.js E → door/container/bench/usable press event; Level 4 home/office handlers and Level 5 l5-door.js/l5-ball.js/l5-hall-door.js handle their respective use cases.

E on lockpick-locked door/container → interact.js shows Pick Lock and calls lockpick.js startPick; lockpick.js reads A/D/W/S, consumes a bobby pin on snap and clears lock on success; lockpick-ui.js renders attempt.
Level 4 phone/printer/shift board → l4-office.js tasks and player.state.l4task; completion writes player.state.payout, which craft.js redeems as XP/items and craft-ui.js displays task progress.

E on tagged seat → interact.js sitDown; scripts/lib/seat.js claims a spot, parents the player and sets sit animation/state; movement/E stands them up, camera.js reads that state, and seatTick maintains/releases the claim.

Level 5 scene manager l5-hall-mgr → l5-hall-lay.js reads l5-hall-layout.js and spawns hall geometry, fixtures and opening guest leaves; scene l5-heat manager → l5-heat.js reads l5-boiler-plan.js, phases steam vents and writes player heat/hp.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state; Level 5 x0z0.scene likewise groups authored hotel detail by room tags.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/level4-geo.js, level4-detail-geo.js, l4-prop-geo.js and look-level4.js - office base, non-colliding lived-in detail, varied abandoned props and post-processing share the Level 4 plan.
scripts/l4-office.js + scripts/l4-office-geo.js - repeated open-floor cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambient sounds, office tasks and supply rewards.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + data/level4-people.yml - Level 4 agents share home/round/meetup/phone/greeting logic, varied by faction, role, voice, look/build and routine.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml - leveled garment lists vary by player/place tier and rarity; faction wardrobe rolls vary by faction, level and stable NPC id across Level 1–4, Gamma and Omega spawners.

scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - Level 0 pack managers with distinct gaze/light/sanity reactions; scripts/hounds.js and scripts/stealers.js adapt shared pursuit/disguise behavior to place grids, safe zones and hunt phase.

scripts/l5-hall-lay.js + l5-hall-geo.js/l5-hall-fix.js - Main Hall/guest-room furniture and fixtures are parameterized by layout rows; placement kind and loot metadata vary geometry, collision, breakability and containers.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene and places/level5/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/seat.js - tagged chairs, sofas and stools share multi-seat interaction and player sit/stand behavior, varied by seat spot count and spacing.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m with hub cells 26–29; Level 1 is 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 is 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 is 26×26 at 4 m; Level 4 is 64×64 m with 8 m-wide, 6 m-deep offices; Level 5 is 96×60 m, x ±48/z ±30.

Level 4 base l4-geo is structural mesh/collider; l4-detail-geo draws ceiling, carpet and wall wear without a collider; l4-prop-geo and l4-office-geo supply repeated placed detail. Scene entries or sim-spawned bodies provide collision.
Level 3 tight cells are 1 m clear width (tightHalf 0.5), 1.6 m springline and 2.15 m crown; tightArms/tightSpans drive structural/detail vaults, and gates/furniture are excluded from crawl halls.

Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, talk.js, build.js, noclip.js, stats.js, craft.js, os.js, lockpick.js, horde.js and critter.js; NPC arrays likewise put locomotion before M.E.G. agent control.

Door IDs are coupled across level-door.js PAIR, place sims' arrival markers and player.js CHECKS (Level 5 routes: l3-lift5 ↔ l5-from-l3, l4-stairs-down ↔ l5-from-l4, l5-lift3/l5-stairs-up return); lock strings use entity.state.lock and lockpick skills.

Level 5 Main Hall manager is authored in x0z0.scene at l5-hall-mgr and lays from PIECES/LEAVES; do not duplicate its room-door leaves. l5-heat is also an authored scene behavior; the plan in l5-boiler-plan.js is shared by it and boiler geometry.
